GameCameraBase.Update.pointer: primary only: Input.GetMouseButton(0) / GetMouseButtonDown(0); no touchCount/GetTouch
GameCameraBase.Update.ui_vs_world: while the button is held, if ShouldConsiderCShapes and CShapeRaycaster.LastResultCount >= 1 the camera does not pan and the last position is forgotten
release: if IsDragging: PlayEndDragTween() unless _isCameraWiderThanScreen; OnEndDrag(); IsDragging = false
GameCameraBase.Update.pointer_down_event: OnPointerDownAction invoked on GetMouseButtonDown(0) before the gate

GameCameraBase.OnDrag.drag_factor: HEIGHT(10.24) / Screen.height world units per pixel, set in Awake
GameCameraBase.OnDrag.pan: x = clamp(camX - (mouse.x - last.x) * factor, GetCameraXBounds()); y = camY - (mouse.y - last.y) * factor; SetPosition(x, y, z)
GameCameraBase.OnDrag.begin_drag: OnBeginDrag() once |clampedX - camX| > 0.01 world units; then IsDragging = true and CShapeRaycaster.enabled = false
GameCameraBase.OnDrag.vertical: y is applied every frame even before IsDragging; only horizontal motion triggers OnBeginDrag
GameCameraBase.OnDrag.inertia: PlayEndDragTween: TweenToXPosition(...) then setEaseOutExpo, skipped when _isCameraWiderThanScreen
decoded_not_asserted: inertia target x = camX + (-10 * factor * dx), duration |factor * dx| (dx = mouse.x - last.x at release)

input_consumers.scope: direct call sites of UnityEngine.Input; attribution = nearest preceding named method
reading: no gameplay (Game.* / PWC.Level*) code calls touchCount, GetTouch, touches or mouseScrollDelta
touches only in CShapeRaycaster.IsTouchBeginPhase and PWCUtils.GetPointerScreenPosition (pointer position)
scroll wheel only in the QA tool SUTSystemTester
multiTouchEnabled written by PazuCore SettingsManager (value from GameExtraSettings.multiTouchEnabled, not recovered) and by HubCanvas (saves, sets false, restores)
